Class AMapMultiPointItem

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.AItem
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.item.AMapItem
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.item.AMapMultiPointItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFeedbackProvider, IDrawable, EventListener
Direct Known Subclasses:
MapPolygonItem, MapPolylineItem
public abstract class AMapMultiPointItem extends AMapItem
Abstract base for map-native items whose geometry is an ordered array of geographic vertices (longitude/latitude in radians).

Shared behaviour

Provides vertex storage, modification lifecycle (drag / vertex resize), hit-testing, bounds, selection handles, projection caching, and feedback. Subclasses (MapPolylineItem, MapPolygonItem) supply only AItem.drawItem(Graphics2D, IContainer) and the buildShape(MapContainer) factory method.

Vertex indexing

Vertices are in _latLons in construction order. For a closed polygon the path is implicitly closed — no duplicate of vertex 0 is stored.

Drag

Raw lon/lat delta from drag-start to current cursor is applied to all vertices from their snapshot positions (no incremental accumulation). Same high-latitude caveat as MapLineItem: at high latitudes a purely northward drag may introduce a small longitudinal error.

Resize

Moves the vertex at ItemModification.getSelectIndex() to the current geographic cursor location.

Rotation

Rotation is silently ignored for arbitrary multi-vertex geographic shapes because there is no single unambiguous spherical rotation centre or "bearing change" for non-line shapes. Subclasses with a well-defined centre (e.g. a geodesic circle) may override modify() to add it.

    • startModification

      public void startModification()
      Classify and begin a drag, resize, or rotate modification.

      Priority: rotate (if start point is in rotation handle) → resize (if start point is in a selection handle) → drag (otherwise).

      This method is a no-op if AItem._modification is null.

      Stores a AMapMultiPointItem.MultiPointStartState snapshot of all vertex positions in the modification's user-object slot.

      Overrides:
      startModification in class AItem

    • modify

      public void modify()
      Update this item's geometry in response to a mouse movement during an active modification.

      Called repeatedly while the user is dragging, resizing, or rotating. The current mouse position is available through AItem._modification.

      DRAG: shifts all vertices by the lon/lat delta from the start snapshot. RESIZE: moves the selected vertex to the cursor. ROTATE: silently ignored.

      Specified by:
      modify in class AItem

    • prepareForRemoval

      public void prepareForRemoval()
      Description copied from class: AItem
      Prepare this item for removal from its layer.

      Performs two operations:

      1. Feedback de-registration. The item unregisters itself from the container's FeedbackControl so that it is no longer polled after removal. The container reference is captured before AItem._layer is nulled.
      2. Reference nulling. Heavyweight references are set to null to assist garbage collection and to cause fast, obvious NullPointerExceptions if the item is used after removal.

      Subclasses holding additional heavyweight references should override this method, null those fields, and call super.prepareForRemoval() either first or last.

      Specified by:
      prepareForRemoval in interface IDrawable
      Overrides:
      prepareForRemoval in class AItem
